verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents one install script and package manager across macOS, Linux and WSL. Brewfile/`brew bundle` is documented to set up project dependencies with one command across these environments and in CI, and it can drive WinGet packages from WSL. A Bluefin user confirms the Linux experience is good. However, Windows support is only through WSL, not native Windows, and some Brewfile entry types (casks, Mac App Store apps) are platform-specific. Missing for 10: native Windows support, documented parity of Brewfile behavior across OSes, and independent corroboration of a single config working identically on all three platforms.
